calibrate_camera(image_array, tag, normalize=False, invert=False)[source]

Calibrate camera.

Calibrate a camera with an array of images of a calibration target. At least 11 good images are required for a good calibration.

Parameters

  • image_array (ndarray[Any, dtype[TypeVar(ScalarType, bound= generic, covariant=True)]]) – Array containing all images that will be used for calibration. It can either be a 3D array (h,w,n) for grayscale images or a 4D array (h,w,c,n) for multi channel images.

  • tag (str) – Feature tag of the calibration target that needs to be detected.

  • normalize (bool) – Specifies whether the images should be normalized before feature detection is carried out, defaults to False.

  • invert (bool) – Specifies whether the images should be inverted before feature detection is carried out, defaults to False.

Return type

CalibrationParameters

Returns

An object that contains all calibration parameter data.

Raises

  • TypeError – When image_array is not a numpy array or calibrator is not a string.

  • CalibrationError – When no features were detected in any of the images.

calibrate_indices(indices)[source]

Repeat calibration with selected samples.

Repeat the camera calibration with the samples specified in indices. This can be used to improve the camera calibration by removing outliers.

Parameters

indices (list) – A list that contains the indices that correspond to the elements in feature_list which should be used for a new calibration. Passing an empty list will perform a calibration with all good images.

Return type

CalibrationParameters

Returns

An object that contains all calibration parameter data.

Raises

  • TypeError – When indices is not a list.

  • CalibrationError – When no images with detected features were selected.

construct_points_lists(indices)[source]

Construct lists of image points and object points for calibration.
